The Court made the following Oral Order

:
Heard Sri V. Jagadeesh, learned Counsel appearing on behalf of Sri Yaswanth Gade, learned Counsel for the Writ Petitioner and Sri K. Arjun Chowdary, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue and Land Acquisition.
2. Sri K. Arjun Chowdary, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue and Land Acquisition has submitted the Written Instruction furnished by the Arbitrator-cum-District Collector, Kakinada District dated 24.07.2024.
Copy of the Written Instruction is also furnished to the learned Counsel for the Writ Petitioner.
This Written Instruction is taken on record.

Relevant portion of the Written Instruction is extracted hereunder:
"It is further submitted that as per sub section 4 of section 3H of NH Act, 1956, "if any dispute arises as to the apportionment of the amount or any part thereof or to any person to whom the same or any part thereof is payable, the Competent Authority shall refer the dispute to the decision of the Principal Civil Court of original jurisdiction within the limits of whose jurisdiction the land is situated".

In the present case, there is no dispute either on title or on apportionment of compensation and the petition filed by the petitioner to pay the compensation in accordance to the rules formulated by the Government is under the consideration of the Arbitrator &
District Collector and it will be disposed of in due course by taking steps under the provisions of Section 3G(5) of NH Act, 1956."
3. The above Written Instruction would indicate that the Representation dated 05.09.2018 (Ex.P.2)
is under active consideration by the Arbitrator-cum- District Collector, Kakinada District (newly impleaded Respondent No.4) and the same will be disposed of in due course as per law.
4. Having considered the Written Instruction extracted hereinabove, this Court deems it appropriate to dispose of this Writ Petition at the admission stage without going into merits of the case with a direction to the newly impleaded Respondent No.4 namely the Arbitrator-cum-District Collector,
Kakinada District, to consider the Representation dated 05.09.2018 (Ex.P.2) and pass a Speaking Order in accordance with law within a period of six weeks from today and communicate such Order to the Writ Petitioner forthwith.
Writ Petitioner is directed to submit a copy of this Order to the Respondent No.4 within one week from today.
5. With these observations and directions, this Writ Petition is disposed of.
6. Interlocutory Applications, if any, stand closed in terms of this Order.
